routes.reason: DY.2 plans nonarchimedean escape rates and reduction on the Berkovich carrier. DY.4 plans the dynamical energy and equidistribution for semipositive adelic metrics. DY.6 asks for proven unlikely-intersection cases as source-bound endpoints with Lattès examples. The paper's escape rates, canonical measures, Arakelov–Zhang energy estimates, Theorems 1.4–1.8, 7.1 and 8.1, Corollary 8.2, the new standard-projection item and Proposition 8.3 of the published version all belong there. Theorem 7.1 must be stated with the repaired η_v above 2 (sourceIssues E7) and (7.5) in its corrected form (E5).

Nothing in the atlas plans potential theory on the Berkovich line (Laplacian, Hsia kernel, mutual energy) or the Boucksom–Jonsson hybrid space. TB.0 constructs Berkovich spectra of Banach rings, the right home for the hybrid space. TB.1 and TB.6 own the metric tree and local measures and heights, so a source route is right.

Uniform Manin–Mumford and Bogomolov for bielliptic genus-2 curves are special cases of the uniform bounds already in this Part II (Kühne; Gao–Ge–Kühne), so the route coalesces with the four other papers under this id. The brief now also asks for Proposition 9.2 of the published version and imports hyperelliptic curves and Weierstrass points from Tau Ceti AlgebraicCurves layers 10–11. A helper agent checked that Stoll's curve y² = x⁶ + 130x³ + 13 is bielliptic, so the brief's B ≥ 34 is right.
